notes: Set newContext({ testIdAttribute }) per context instead of one global, mutable setting; the program that creates or reclaims a context chooses it, and omitting it on a reclaim keeps the current one. Locators keep the attribute they were made with; relative locators take the one of the locator they filter. Default data-testid; an invalid attribute name fails with InvalidInput.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: The attribute `getByTestId` matches is a context's setting, chosen by the program that creates or reclaims the context, so sibling contexts never share it.
